META.derivation: LaTeX metadata/structure is nonmathematical except the abstract at L41.

INTRO.hypotheses: independent real coordinates with density cap K; A real symmetric; b,c arbitrary
INTRO.dependencies: definitions of singular values and scaling
INTRO.derivation: Checked theorem quantifiers, singular-value/eigenvalue equivalence for symmetric A, counterexamples for 1/2 directions, pivot outline and crossing-volume definitions.
INTRO.downstream: sets theorem scope and proof case split

F1.hypotheses: standard Fourier convention; f in stated Lp classes
F1.derivation: Verified Fourier normalization, Gaussian representation/Fubini domination, power-envelope integral 2ap/(p-1), and density factor 1/(2π).

F2.dependencies: F1 Gaussian identity; Gamma integral; Tonelli
F2.derivation: Recomputed Laplace representation of |z|^-1/2 and v-integral, obtaining 1/sqrt(2π); integrated min(1,u/|t|) against |t|^-1/2 to get 8 sqrt(u).

COND.hypotheses: U,V independent; conditional domination by g
COND.derivation: Integrated the conditional measure inequality over V; null Borel sets remain null and yield a density dominated a.e. by E g; integrated nonnegative test functions.

WEYL.hypotheses: matching matrix sizes; indicated rank/orthonormal columns
WEYL.derivation: Checked approximation-number proof of Lipschitz singular values, low-rank shift and orthogonal compression; L148 'Both' is grammar only.

SCHUR.hypotheses: A symmetric block matrix; B invertible
SCHUR.dependencies: block inverse; Cauchy interlacing; WEYL continuity
SCHUR.derivation: For invertible A, lower-right block of A^-1 is S^-1 and interlacing compares eigenvalues outside ±1/t; perturb A,B by εI and pass ε→0 for singular A.

GRAM.hypotheses: finite matrices; Θ(H)>0 in part b
GRAM.derivation: Verified elementary-symmetric/Gram-minor identity and residual Gram determinant after orthogonal projection.

BL.hypotheses: geometric frame sum c_i u_i u_i^T=I; c_i>0
BL.dependencies: heat equation; integration by parts; Fatou/monotone/dominated convergence
BL.derivation: Recomputed heat-flow differential identity, contraction inequality, Gaussian tail domination, τ→∞ normalization, τ↓0 Fatou step, and truncation to general h_i.

PROJ.hypotheses: independent coordinates, each density ≤1; U orthonormal columns or B full row rank
PROJ.dependencies: BL; orthogonal coordinate change; linear Jacobian
PROJ.derivation: Derived U^T X density integral, β_i=|w_i|^2 frame, BL entropy bound e^{d/2}, and SVD scaling. L222 contains a false zero-β count; dropping all zero-β factors repairs it without changing the frame or constant.
PROJ.downstream: linear-form caps, decay compiler, pivot estimates

FPOWER.derivation: Checked difference density cap 1, m=floor(p/2) reduction, integrability, sum-of-differences characteristic function and projection bound, yielding 2πsqrt(2e)/sqrt p.

DECAYDEF.hypotheses: product cap-one laws; fixed physical partition I∪J
DECAYDEF.derivation: Checked crossing-volume definitions and exact E_l=e_l(MM^T)=sum squared minors.

ENTROPY.derivation: Expanded marginals, applied Jensen/concavity, bounded distinct-index monomials by (sum α)^m/m!, and used sum α=m.

HUB.hypotheses: Θ_l(H)>0; diffuse marginals ≤1/2 when k<l; original-coordinate independence
HUB.dependencies: GRAM, PROJ, FPOWER, ENTROPY, Plancherel, Cauchy-Schwarz/Hölder, mollifier L2 convergence
HUB.derivation: Reconstructed k=0 decoupling and k≥1 physical-hub Plancherel route, complex measure domination, mollification, weighted Hölder, joint projection Jacobian, scalar Fourier powers and entropy. L319-321 omits |E F|^2≤E|F|^2; inserting Jensen/Cauchy is constant-neutral.

DECAYTHM.derivation: Verified greedy hub promotion, Θ_l(H)≥2^-k E_l, diffuse stopping, monotonic a_k via ω(m)/ω(m-1)≥1, and final constant.

DECAYCOR.derivation: Took square roots of |φ|^2 decay and independently recomputed l=3 density, l=2 halfmoment and l=1 characteristic-function constants.

SQUARE.hypotheses: one cap-one density; nonzero quadratic coefficient
SQUARE.derivation: Checked two inverse branches, Jacobian 2sqrt(|a||z-v|), density envelope and interval preimage length ≤2sqrt(2ρ/|a|).

DEFINITE.hypotheses: W in R^2 has density ≤L; quadratic matrix definite
DEFINITE.derivation: Completed square, diagonalized deterministically, computed polar Jacobian 1/(2sqrt(det B)); L412's literal global-diffeomorphism claim is false at angular seam, repaired by deleting one null ray/a.e. chart.

HYPERBOLA.hypotheses: two original coordinates independent with densities ≤1; B nondegenerate indefinite
HYPERBOLA.dependencies: 2D hyperbolic change of variables; original-coordinate density caps
HYPERBOLA.derivation: Verified branch parametrization/Jacobian, separate positive-tail i and negative-tail i' choices, monotone original-coordinate substitutions, cutoff bound and AM-GM determinant scaling. L441 must explicitly exclude an atom at critical level; zero level is two affine lines and hence null under joint density.
HYPERBOLA.downstream: indefinite pair density and pair halfmoment

CONCENTRATION.hypotheses: S symmetric nonzero; product cap-one coordinates
CONCENTRATION.derivation: Checked diagonal case, random-cut Frobenius expectation ||O||_F^2/4, selected crossing norm ≥L/4, Gaussian smoothing integral and <19 constant; layer cake gives L0=2+2log19 and excludes atoms.

KERNELS.derivation: Recomputed J(d), split d≤1/d>1, product bound ≤4, and centered-interval rearrangement by superlevel intersections.

PAIRHALF.hypotheses: two independent cap-one variables; det B≠0
PAIRHALF.derivation: Checked bounded-density halfmoment identity 2sqrt(2M), definite constant, indefinite scaling, δ=1/64 truncation and rearranged integral 4+5log2; total <16D^-1/4.

SIGNPARAM.derivation: Verified η^2+ζ=(5/48)^2 and no-pivot diagonal/off-diagonal entry bounds.

CROSS.derivation: Checked A-DAD=2C entrywise and block dilation singular-value duplication.

SIGNS.hypotheses: zero-diagonal symmetric O; independent Rademacher signs
SIGNS.derivation: Expanded ||Qε||_F^2; only ordered-pair matches survive; bounded dot products and entries to get 2a^2(sum|φ_i|^2)^2.

PROPSIGNS.dependencies: Section 6 machine-checked facts per current owner instruction; WEYL, CROSS, SIGNS
PROPSIGNS.derivation: Independently checked textual interfaces: eigenframe trace k, good-sign Frobenius/operator bound, compressed identity, perturbation margin γ_m, compression, block duplication and E_m lower bound. Machine-checked spectral facts treated completed as instructed.

NOPIVOT.derivation: Applied m=3/m=2 crossing-volume lower bounds; independently recomputed C3/γ3<167 and C2/sqrt(γ2)<26.

HALFPOTENTIAL.dependencies: NOPIVOT, PAIRHALF, SQUARE, COND, SCHUR, CONCENTRATION, KERNELS
HALFPOTENTIAL.derivation: Checked exhaustive no-pivot/pair/diagonal alternatives; pair ≤64; diagonal Schur loses one spectral direction, J-kernel near part <76 and far part ≤1, total <77.
HALFPOTENTIAL.downstream: diagonal branch of main theorem and scaled s3 halfmoment

MAIN.hypotheses: first K=s=1, s5(A)≥1; then K,s>0 scaling
MAIN.dependencies: NOPIVOT, HALFPOTENTIAL, SCHUR, SQUARE, COND, DEFINITE, HYPERBOLA, CONCENTRATION
MAIN.derivation: Checked exhaustive cases: no pivot <167; diagonal pivot sqrt12*77<267; definite pair 16π<51; indefinite Schur has ≥3 large eigenvalues and log envelope <269. Verified Y=KX scaling gives K^2/s.

REMARK.dependencies: main scaling; explicit star block algebra
REMARK.derivation: Checked s3 halfmoment scaling and one-direction divergence; checked two-star spectrum ±1 twice, no pivot for N>256 and cross-block rank≤2. These are scope/method remarks, not a lower-threshold project.
